components.design_basis: Source-compatible modular adaptation; unseen backs/joins and dimensions proposed
components.notes: 3m-wide cream plaster/oak-frame wall, visible30cm thickness, round-topped1.2x1.4m aperture, sill0.8m above floor. Show an actual empty through opening, no flat painted false window. End posts meet at3m pitch; glass/frameD03 installed later. Warm stone plinth atfoot; restrained source timber lattice, no palace marble. All four named sections are present. The corrected sheet separates flat wall bays S01/S02, upper gable end S03 and roof repeat S04. The first draft added an unwanted roof to each wall bay and is preserved. S04’s small front/back sketches still resemble solid wood triangles despite the open-end caption. Do not treat them as approved end closures or opening masks. Build the roof as two backed planes from the proposed interface dimensions, and remove end infill before joining repeats. The wall thickness, storey heights, aperture sizes and roof pitch are proposed. Repeated end posts and stone feet may overlap. Floors, corner sealing, roof lining, chimney flashing and view-to-view geometry parity remain unresolved.

components.name: Upper gable end

components.construction: Full6m-wide upper gable wall:2.6m rectangular wall plus2.8m steep triangular gable, maximum5.4m high measured from upper-floor base. End-only module; not stacked atop another upper endwall.
